flags.text: Auto-renewal window approaching: the agreement auto-renews for a 1-year term on 2026-10-01 unless written non-renewal notice is delivered by 2026-08-02 (60 days prior).

Change of control of Vendor is deemed an assignment requiring Buyer's prior written consent; without consent, Buyer may terminate immediately. Vendor must give 30 days notice of any proposed change of control.
Tenant must maintain commercial general liability insurance of $2M per occurrence / $4M aggregate naming Landlord as additional insured, with renewal certificates delivered by September 15 each year.
The single 5-year renewal option lapses unless exercised in writing by 2027-05-31 (9 months before the 2028-02-29 expiration); time is of the essence.

deadlines.text: Last day to deliver written non-renewal notice (60 days before the 2026-10-01 renewal); otherwise the agreement auto-renews for one year (Sec. 2.2).
Deliver annual insurance renewal certificates to Landlord evidencing required coverage (Sec. 9.2).
First 1-year Renewal Term commences if no timely non-renewal notice was given (Sec. 2.2).

goldens.q: How is the vendor supply agreement renewed, and what notice is required to prevent renewal?
goldens.expected: It automatically renews for successive 1-year terms unless either party gives written non-renewal notice at least 60 days before the end of the current term; the first renewal term begins 2026-10-01.

goldens.q: What is the cap on liability under the supply agreement with Cascade Consumer Goods?
goldens.expected: Each party's total aggregate liability is capped at the fees paid or payable by Buyer to Vendor in the 12 months preceding the claim, with carve-outs for indemnification and gross negligence or willful misconduct.

goldens.q: What renewal option does Blue Harbor have under the Portsmouth store lease, and by when must it be exercised?
goldens.expected: One option to extend for 5 years, exercisable only by written notice to Landlord at least 9 months before the 2028-02-29 expiration, i.e. on or before 2027-05-31.

goldens.q: Which state's law governs the NDA with Lighthouse Analytics, and where must disputes be brought?
goldens.expected: Delaware law governs, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware.

goldens.q: What is the personal phone number of Blue Harbor's CFO?
goldens.expected: Not found in the provided documents.
